name: Layers tab creates new layers and modifies blend mode and visibility
description: Verify adding new layers, adjusting opacity, changing blend modes, and toggling visibility.

planSteps.description: Click the Layers tab in the right inspector panel
Verify the layers header displays Layers (1) and Layer 1 is active
Click the Add New Layer button in the layer toolbar
Verify the layer count updates to Layers (2) and Layer 2 appears in the layer stack
Click the visibility eye icon on Layer 2
Verify the visibility eye icon toggles to its hidden state
Select Multiply from the blend mode dropdown
Verify the blend mode dropdown shows Multiply as the selected value
